test: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash IQ2_XXS, two-GPU expert helper, sustained serving

hardware.cpu: AMD Ryzen 7 3700X, 8 cores / 16 threads, 8 engine threads
hardware.placement: physical GPU 1 (fast, PCIe 4 x16): layers and native vision; physical GPU 0 (slower PCIe link): 24 GB expert helper
hardware.links: about 26.3 GB/s to GPU 1 and 2.86 GB/s to GPU 0, no peer access

method: same preserved 8130-token review prompt and 512 greedy output tokens (temperature 0, finish reason length) per request; 524288-token allocation; private copy of the same profile seed; startup excluded; a cold request after load followed by a repeat request that reuses 8129 prompt tokens; serving run, not a fixed-token microbenchmark, so free-generated continuations can differ

reproduction.note: fresh build of this branch on the same machine, prompt and preset

controls.note: same engine, same prompt and method, one card
separate engine implementation, external control only, not the configuration this repository packages

limits: One cold and one repeat request per configuration; not a sweep and not a fixed-token causal isolation.
The helper sums selected experts on GPU 0 instead of the CPU lane; the engine documents that this can change the last bits of an answer. No bit-identity or full-model quality claim is made.
All six routed experts remain enabled; no expert dropping, precision reduction or context reduction.
DSpark drafting and suffix drafting were off.
Linux and CUDA are the measured path; Windows and AMD helper paths are untested upstream.
Repeat prefill is small because 8129 prompt tokens were reused from the cold request's cache.
sanitisation: Only throughput, timing, allocation and configuration scalars are published; token arrays, prompt ids, generated text, request bodies, monitor streams and logs are not.
No GPU UUIDs, absolute home paths or machine-local profile paths are included; GPU roles are described by physical index and link speed.
The original artifacts above remain the primary record; this file is a checked scalar extract.
